requested_sections: 서비스 개요 및 공모전 차별화 포인트
Pleos 화면 맞춤 UI/UX 상세 설계서
데이터베이스 스키마 및 상태 관리 구조
예외 처리 및 안전 규제 대응 방안
scope_decisions: Pleos-equipped vehicles only, IVI main app and Android backup.
Complete official target-vehicle warning/indicator/message catalog, not three warning types.
Available approved sensors only; no invented public IMU/motor RPM/DTC APIs or direct raw CAN/VHAL access.
Numerical vibration/crash rules are LAB starting values, not OEM safety criteria; production motion model disabled by default.
Same guide pipeline for user reports with distinct USER_REPORTED provenance.
Sensor incident to server immediately, external guardian dispatch after requested 10s countdown or send-now.
Kakao first and backend-owned text fallback; no concurrent provider-native resend.
Severity is estimated response priority, not injury or damage diagnosis; response absent is not unconsciousness.
1280x720dp is authored application viewport, not a universal official Pleos panel resolution.
Voice and explanation animation share guide/step/version, subject to actual driving/window permissions.

reference.read_with: public ref MCP get_reference + contact sheet + get_reference_images
reference.adopted: dark hierarchy, accent, pills, cards, avatar status, wide CTA
reference.not_adopted: portrait phone frames, small bottom navigation and social-content layout

sources.supports: Published first-round criteria and real working app requirement for second round; no unpublished score weights inferred.
Application window, driving/system regions, display families and landscape/portrait adaptation; no universal numeric pixel viewport found.
Contrast >=4.5:1; physical important glyph >=5mm and secondary >=3mm, concise text.
Window resizing, foreground/background and protected Driving view.
CarUxRestrictions, limited moving graphics/video and audio focus; no emergency bypass established.
Platform-only hardware access, restricted sensors/mobile APIs and network loss design.
Actual target capability/property availability and technical review for special properties.
PERF_VEHICLE_SPEED, ENGINE_RPM, WHEEL_TICK and front-wheel vs steering-wheel angle distinctions; permission and target-version constraints.
sources.limit: Search/cache rendering differed on permission text; current direct original HTML explicitly showed ENGINE_RPM 3P-or-privileged permission. No Pleos target grant tested.

sources.supports: Raw/linear acceleration and gyro definitions and sensor availability differences, not safety-quality guarantees.
Platform VHAL architecture, not public direct app hardware permission.
Informational AlimTalk, approved templates and properly collected recipient numbers; no emergency-template approval inferred.
BizMessage corporate service contract boundary; not treated as universal ready-to-send personal Kakao API.
Normal v2.3 messages path, request/recipient response, result lookup, optional resend, auth/messages is OTP-specific, provider idempotency window.
SMS v3.0 and long-message mms path; EUC-KR SMS90/LMS2000/title40 byte limits and request fields.
Server coordinate-to-address route, x longitude/y latitude; not proof of API account availability.
Condition-dependent warning meanings and action structure.
sources.limit: Reference model not confirmed Pleos; target content not adopted as verified production guide.
No detailed EV rules claimed from this short page and no Pleos fitment inferred.
No numeric64dp requirement attributed to the page; 64dp is authored design choice.

initial_findings_addressed: Manual minimum levels synchronized with numerical severity.
Overlapping impulse windows excluded from persistent vibration voting; synthetic counterexample reproduced.
Uniform grid/160Hz gate/10ms interpolation gap reflected in pseudocode.
Generic help separated from emergency moving-vehicle braking guidance.
Absolute text-fallback deadline starts on first submission even if HTTP response is lost.
Offline countdown clock fields, formula and cancellation creation intent defined.
Rows/pages computed from actual body height in all width profiles.
contract_findings_addressed: Append observation/guidance batch API and immutable sequence/revision rules added.
Owner incident/timeline/location and guardian projection/download APIs added.
Resumable4MiB offset protocol and SQL sessions/chunks defined.
MONOTONIC_ONLY countdown requires usable elapsed time.
